results.title: Infected
results.overview: A group of survivors facing an apocalyptic world of the living dead must join forces to survive.

results.title: God Is Shy
results.overview: During a train ride, Ariel and Paul pass the time sketching their deepest fears. Their game takes an unexpected turn when Gilda, a mysterious passenger, intrudes on their exchange. Yet, her relationship with fear seems far less innocent than their playful drawings.

results.title: Son of a Rich 3
results.overview: Grisha, who has successfully managed projects to correct spoiled brats, now faces a difficult task – reeducating not just one person, but an entire family.

results.title: Massa Mãe
results.overview: Maria and Matías feel life is slipping through their fingers, and turn to birds, real and imagined, in a search for meaning and connection.

results.title: Exodus 1945: Our Blood
results.overview: May 1945, Ljubljana. Following the end of World War II and the communist seizure of power, many opponents of communism flee Yugoslavia, retreating to Austrian Carinthia toward the British Allies. On a medical train from Ljubljana, alongside wounded members of the Home Guard, travel two physicians: Dr. Janez Janež and Dr. Valentin Meršol with his family. Their principles and consciences are put to the test as they face the brutal truth that they cannot save everyone - the survival of some will mean the death of others.

results.title: Velvet Fire
results.overview: Silvana, a young trans woman, faces the gradual collapse of her relationship while carrying a wound that shapes her present: the belief that she cannot be loved. Amid confusion, jealousy, and the urge to hold on to what is falling apart, she receives news that forces her to confront her family past. Along the way, Silvana must choose the life she wants to build and whether she can break free from the idea that she is destined for loneliness.

results.title: John-Luke Roberts: Stdad-Up
results.overview: How do you make a show about your recently deceased father, when you didn’t like him much?  Probably not by dressing up as him in a huge suit filled with balloons and performing him as a furious insult comic, but that’s what this show is.

results.title: Phoenix Fury
results.overview: When Ewura-Ama, recently widowed, inherits Utopia Valley, a luxury resort tucked in the quiet hills of Ghana, her search for solitude is disrupted by the arrival of a high-profile guest. Their uneasy encounter stirs tensions that awaken secrets buried decades ago.

results.title: Evil Has Always Had a Name
results.original_title: Evil Has Always Had a Name
results.overview: In the midst of the chaos in Raccoon City following a virus outbreak, a mother and daughter traverse the infected-filled streets in pursuit of safety.

results.title: AAA Ola de Calor 2026
results.overview: Ola de Calor 2026 (Spanish for "Heat Wave") was a professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by Mexican professional wrestling promotion Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) in partnership with its parent company WWE. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right before NXT Heatwave in the same venue.

results.title: Little Birds
results.overview: Two girls escape from their bleak world into one of their own; but when their game of flight takes a dark turn, one is left to face the consequences alone.

results.title: The Badger of Ballybog
results.overview: The Badger of Ballybog is a comedy mockumentary following the contestants of Ireland’s premier men’s beauty pageant, including five-time reigning champ Little Johnny, legacy entrant Mícheál Milk, competition bad boy Big Daddy, the young and eager Declan Dweeb, international man of mystery Nakamura Ozu, English pariah Paddy Maguire and American folk singer Duke Davis. It’s like the Rose of Tralee, but for lads.

results.title: Long Game: The Bernie Sanders Effect
results.original_title: Long Game: The Bernie Sanders Effect
results.overview: Ahead of the 2026 midterm elections, MS NOW Senior Contributing Editor Michele Norris takes an in-depth look at the groundbreaking career and burgeoning influence of Sen. Bernie Sanders. Through exclusive sit-down interviews with Sanders, Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, and New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, Norris explores the Senator’s role in shaping a new generation of candidates and political leaders who are redefining the Democratic Party.

results.title: Mr. & Mrs. Christmas
results.overview: Taylor Lewis, a single father and expert in holiday displays, moves to the picturesque town of Pineway with his two children just weeks before Christmas. While the family adjusts to a new home and school, Taylor also faces the realization that his teenage daughter may be growing out of some of their treasured Christmas traditions.  When Taylor becomes involved in reviving Pineway's Christmas Market, he's paired with Sophie Shaw, a practical accountant eager to prove herself as a potential leader. Their different approaches soon complement each other, bringing new life and festive spirit to the town.  As Taylor tries to hold onto the Christmas traditions his family once shared, he discovers that meaningful moments can't simply be recreated. Growing closer to Sophie along the way, he begins to see that embracing change can lead to new traditions, new memories, and perhaps an unexpected new beginning.

results.title: Holy Relic
results.overview: When a troubled father discovers a malevolent presence inhabiting a religious artifact, he investigates with the help of his two young sons.

results.title: Anbe Diana
results.overview: Set in Perambur, a local Telugu youth falls for an Anglo-Indian girl, sparking a chaotic and humorous clash of cultures between their families.

results.title: Shimmera
results.overview: A mysterious man inhabits a home that is not his own. His true nature is revealed when nine different visitors come to the door one by one.

results.title: Mother Earth
results.overview: An alien race weaponizes humanity's anger and fear, turning the people of Earth against one another until mankind destroys itself. But as the last humans fall, the invaders discover something their species has never known. A mother's love.

results.title: Zeruya Shalev – Wie man Liebe schreibt im Krieg
results.original_title: Zeruya Shalev – Wie man Liebe schreibt im Krieg
results.overview: Zeruya Shalev is the voice of Israel. Her topics: family conflicts, love and pain. In the film, she tells her family story which is inextricably linked to the founding of Israel.
